generated_from: Solana Foundation changelog dated 2026-08-20 and public Feature Program account read observed 2026-08-28

activation.verification_method: Public getAccountInfo decoded the Feature Program account activation slot and public getBlockTime mapped that slot to a block time.

records.measurement_role: Reference window for read-only landing, confirmation, replay, catchup, and oracle-age metrics before the activation boundary.
benchmark_uses: Normalize slot-indexed observations by the pre-activation target duration.
Compare only source-compatible metrics with matching provider, commitment, and query settings.
Treat venue-level effects as open questions until separate Drift, Jupiter, or Phoenix evidence exists.
blocked_claims: No latency, landing, skip-rate, spread, or market-quality improvement claim.

records.measurement_role: Reference window for read-only landing, confirmation, replay, catchup, and oracle-age metrics after the activation boundary.
benchmark_uses: Normalize post-activation slot-indexed observations by the new target duration.
Report deltas only as methodology outputs until source-backed performance analysis exists.
Keep later feature gates, Votor, VAT, rent changes, and Alpenglow in separate unverified strata.
blocked_claims: No lower oracle-age or replay-pressure claim.
No protocol safety or trading-performance claim.

known_gaps: This package records a source-governed benchmark boundary, not measured cluster performance.
Observed slot duration, confirmation timing, landing quality, replay, catchup, skip-rate, and market-quality effects require separate source-compatible measurements.
Later slot-time gates, Votor, VAT, rent changes, transaction-v1, and Alpenglow are not represented as active without independent feature-account evidence.
